searchText: Hey all! We have a timeslot for Devconnect in Istanbul on Nov 18! Please signal here if you have a presentation you'd like to make so we can create an agenda for the day's activities. Ticketing information to be posted on (https://lightclients.xyz) and on Twitter (https://twitter.com/EthLightClients) as we get closer to the actual event.
